Security._comment: Intentionally empty here. Outside Development, Program.cs refuses to start unless this is set via an environment variable or secret store (e.g. ASPNETCORE_Security__ApiKey / Key Vault) — never commit a real key to this file.

Jwt._comment: Intentionally empty here, same reasoning as ApiKey above (e.g. ASPNETCORE_Security__Jwt__SigningKey / Key Vault). Build Day 32 replaces this whole symmetric-key setup with a real IdP (Authority/Audience config only, per ADR-001).
